items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the dualizing complex and sheaf of a closed subscheme by RSheafHom against the ambient ones (statement lines 976-986). The proof (lines 988-1004) is a complete adjunction chain: the composition of right adjoints from uniqueness, the RSheafHom description of the closed-subspace adjoint, the H^{-1} extraction, and the pushforward upgrade via the exact-support lemma. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a compact adjunction argument with correctly ordered citations.
